SCE.S:437854: Strange cases keep him from sleeping. Last night he saw a five-armed monster in the library. A dream?
SCE.S:437920: The government can't agree how to go public. Many Info Ministry staff are here investigating.
SCE.S:4379EC: Moved to a desk job this April. Lost in paperwork, and the City's state has frayed his nerves.
SCE.S:437AB8: 20 years on the force. Tactless and arrogant; even colleagues avoid him. Not a very good cop.
SCE.S:437B84: Famous detective of many tough cases; old-school legwork. These serial cases baffle him.
SCE.S:437C50: Ex-police chief. Keeps the City calm on the surface. Hobby: keeping up appearances.
SCE.S:437D1C: Since junior high he has lived as if dreaming. One dream ended, and the next began.
SCE.S:437DE8: Mild-mannered. Spends days off watching a week of taped anime.
SCE.S:437EB4: Chief's nephew. After seeing a doctor for a cold, his leg swelled hugely within 3 hours.
SCE.S:437F80: Cornered by mutants, he fled in here. Two days without food, living on toilet water.
